sections.title: 10. QUICK REFERENCE: FORMULAS
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│               KEY FORMULAS                                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                     │
│  ATTENTION:                                                         │
│  Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(QK^T / √d_k) × V                       │
│                                                                     │
│  MULTI-HEAD ATTENTION:                                              │
│  MultiHead(Q,K,V) = Concat(head_1,...,head_h) × W_O                │
│  where head_i = Attention(QW_Q^i, KW_K^i, VW_V^i)                  │
│                                                                     │
│  FFN (GELU variant):                                                │
│  FFN(x) = W_2 × GELU(W_1 × x + b_1) + b_2                          │
│                                                                     │
│  FFN (SwiGLU variant - LLaMA):                                      │
│  FFN(x) = (Swish(x × W_gate) ⊙ (x × W_up)) × W_down               │
│                                                                     │
│  LAYER NORM:                                                        │
│  LayerNorm(x) = γ × (x - μ) / √(σ² + ε) + β                        │
│                                                                     │
│  RMS NORM (LLaMA):                                                  │
│  RMSNorm(x) = x / √(mean(x²) + ε) × γ                              │
│                                                                     │
│  POSITIONAL ENCODING (Sinusoidal):                                  │
│  PE(pos, 2i) = sin(pos / 10000^(2i/d))                             │
│  PE(pos, 2i+1) = cos(pos / 10000^(2i/d))                           │
│                                                                     │
│  ROTARY POSITION EMBEDDING (RoPE):                                  │
│  f(x, pos) = R(pos × θ) × x                                        │
│  where R(θ) is rotation matrix                                     │
│                                                                     │
│  CROSS-ENTROPY LOSS:                                                │
│  L = -Σᵢ log P(correct_token_i | context)                          │
│                                                                     │
│  PERPLEXITY:                                                        │
│  PPL = exp(L) = exp(-1/N × Σ log P(token_i))                       │
│                                                                     │
│  SCALING LAWS:                                                      │
│  L(N,D) ≈ (N_c/N)^α_N + (D_c/D)^α_D + L_∞                         │
│  Optimal: D ≈ 20 × N (Chinchilla)                                  │
│                                                                     │
│  COMPUTE (FLOPs):                                                   │
│  Training: C ≈ 6 × N × D                                           │
│  Inference: C ≈ 2 × N per token                                    │
│                                                                     │
│  MEMORY (Training):                                                 │
│  Memory ≈ 16 × N bytes (FP16 + AdamW optimizer states)            │
│                                                                     │
│  LORA:                                                              │
│  W' = W + ΔW = W + A × B                                           │
│  where A ∈ ℝ^(d×r), B ∈ ℝ^(r×d), r << d                           │
│                                                                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

This comprehensive guide covers the major aspects of Transformer architecture from theoretical foundations to practical deployment scenarios. The visual explanations and detailed examples should help you understand both the concepts and their practical applications in interviews and real-world projects.

**Key takeaways:**

1. Attention is the core innovation - understand the math deeply
2. Modern LLMs use many optimizations (RoPE, GQA, Flash Attention)
3. Efficient inference is as important as training
4. Evaluation should be multi-dimensional
5. Start from pre-trained models unless you have specific reasons not to

Good luck with your interviews and projects! 🚀
